items.h: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen as its everyday model
items.sum: The fast, lower-cost model succeeds Gemini 3.8 Flash and is rolling out across the Gemini app, Search and developer access.

items.h: Trans-Siberian Orchestra brings its holiday show to Climate Pledge Arena
items.sum: The Ghosts of Christmas Eve tour plays Seattle Center on Sunday, Nov. 29.

items.h: Thundercat, Jai Wolf and Julien Baker fill the Showbox and Neumos this weekend
items.sum: Shows run from Thursday through Saturday across SoDo, Pike Place Market and Capitol Hill.

items.h: Steve Lacy comes to WaMu Theater on Nov. 28
items.sum: The R&B and soul artist plays Seattle later this month as part of the fall concert run.

items.h: Restaurant openings coming soon across Seattle
items.sum: New spots on the list include GoodMart in Ballard, Rubys at Pike Place Market, Char The Chicken in Capitol Hill and Gohan in Beacon Hill.
